title: SimpleReporting
description: SimpleReport lets players easily report others, saving reports to a file while notifying console and showing a firework.
body:
SimpleReport is a lightweight and easy-to-use reporting plugin for Minecraft servers. Players can quickly report others using /report <player> <reason>, and all reports are automatically saved to a text file in the plugin folder. Each report triggers a firework at the reporter’s location and sends a confirmation message, while all reports are logged to the console for staff to review. Simple to install and configure, SimpleReport is perfect for server owners who want a straightforward, no-fuss way to keep their community safe.
